scope: the v2 editor's Show-level surface: output contract, Stage map, Zone Map rename, Trails, and the header's View code and Download .epe
invariants: The editor writes only through the existing showCommandsV2 owners: set_output_contract, set_stage_map, update_zone, set_output_trails. No second writer, no new mutation rule, no compiler or schema widening.
One accepted Show-metadata edit is one preparation, one history entry and one provider save; a refusal or no-op prepares nothing, writes nothing and returns the original record identity.
The record after an editor edit equals the record after applyShowCommandV2 with the same input, so a person and an agent produce identical bytes.

A Stage map an accepted edit newly names is re-resolved through resolveShowV2StageMap before the candidate is prepared; a map that is gone, empty or at an unsupported dimension refuses and adopts nothing. No fallback map is ever substituted.
The projection reports what the record names: a map absent from this workspace reads as missing, never as another map's name.
The header's Download .epe and the delivery panel's Export .epe are one implementation writing the same bytes under the filename the v1 exporter produces.
Zone add/remove and Layout-definition routing have no v2 owner; the surface records them as residuals instead of inventing one.
partitions: contract kind: portable to portable (map, count), portable to installation, installation map/count, already-satisfied no-op
contract map eligibility: 2D-only list for Portable, every map for Installation, explicit null clear
Stage map: absent to named, named to another named, named to a workspace-missing id (refused), unchanged
Zone: rename, duplicate name (refused), blank name (refused), unknown id (refused), nominal pixel count
Trails: off to on at the default retention, retune, on to off, unchanged
intent shape: null/empty/array/missing input/extra field, and a command outside the allowlist (remove_clips, set_show_end, rename_show)
admission currency: record, revision, provider and route replacement
artifacts: ready bundle, and a blocked delivery with neither action offered
viewport: desktop 1440 and narrow 390 keyboard traversal
sequences: create a Portable Show at 1024 reference pixels through the production flow -> read the summary -> apply an Installation contract with a chosen map and count -> move the Stage map alone -> Fast and Precise Stage capture -> rename a Zone -> Undo -> enable Trails -> reload -> export .pxlshow -> reopen through parseShowFileBundle
View code -> Back to show -> Download .epe -> reopen through parseEpe -> 390 px keyboard traversal and control-bounds check
header Download .epe then panel Export .epe on one capture, compared byte for byte apart from the freshly minted program id
oracles: Provider readback through GET /api/shows?show-version=2: the stored record's outputContract, stageMapId, zones and outputEffects.
The exported .pxlshow reopened through parseShowFileBundle and the exported .epe reopened through parseEpe, both in the live page.
Real store state and history: useShowStore showV2Pilots identity and showV2Histories past length after each admission outcome.
The real prepared-stage call: prepareShowStageV2 call count and the stageMap dependency it was handed.
Stage preview frames captured in both Fast and Precise after the Stage map change.
The registry itself for the residual rows: which commands touch /zones and /zoneLayouts, and the compiler's own refusal for an unrouted Zone.

residualGaps: Adding or removing a Zone has no v2 owner and no command. Counterexample: appending a valid Zone to `zones` is not enough - every Layout definition must route it, or preparation refuses the whole Show with `compileShow routed scene sequence references missing zone "Spare"`; removal must additionally carry the Zone's Layers, Clips, Transitions, Group occurrences and Property tracks. Held as assertions in src/engine/showV2ShowSurfaceResiduals.test.ts.

A Zone Layout definition's routing mode and operator have no v2 owner and no command. `make_layout_interval_unique` is the only command that touches `/zoneLayouts`, and it only appends a clone: no command reaches a definition's `logical` field, so an agent cannot change a routing mode either.
Zone LED range selection on the Stage (`ShowZoneSpatialSelector`) stays v1-only for the same reason: it writes a Layout definition's per-Zone physical ranges, which no v2 owner writes.

The output contract's pixel count is clamped by `createPortableShowOutputContract`/`createInstallationShowOutputContract` as it always has been; the surface bounds its field at MAX_PORTABLE_PREVIEW_PIXELS and reports the value the record kept, but does not warn that a request was clamped.
Trails retention is authored as a percentage field; the compiled-artifact rejection notice the v1 panel shows when another cache owns the frame arena has no counterpart here.
Final authoritative committed-tip suites and the cross-family review belong to the coordinator.
